correctness.rationale: For every n>=5, S_n=C_n^2 has adjacency interpreted in C_n by x!=y AND (E_C(x,y) OR exists z E_C(x,z) AND E_C(z,y)); this adds at most one quantifier. Brown--Hoshino (2007), Theorem 4.9, establishes C_m equiv_5 C_n for m,n>=19, hence S_m equiv_4 S_n. The recursive exact tuple-type invariant tau_{r+1}(a)=(atomic diagram,{tau_r(a,b):b in V}) is equivalent to bounded-rank equivalence. I independently compiled and ran the supplied dihedral-reduced C++ recurrence, not just read its transcript: ranks-four empty-tuple type IDs for n=5..18 were all distinct, and n=19..24 shared ID 364. This computational finite distinction plus the analytic published infinite-tail implication prove the full family classification, 15 classes and sharp tail at 19; finite computation alone does not prove the infinite tail.
